notes:
AE notes / call highlights:
- Company: QuasarKeel — VS Code extension focused on enterprise teams (in-house dev tools + commercial extension).
- Primary ask: low-latency streaming completion (in-editor inline suggestions) that feels instant. Dev lead: "users drop suggestion if first token >120ms". Target: first-token <=100ms, sustained token rps for multi-suggestion streams.
- Model/version pinning: must be able to pin stable model for GA release (no silent upgrades). Need model aliasing + explicit rollback endpoint.
- Auth & rate-limits: extension will use customer tokens for orgs + freemium anonymous tokens for public testers. Concern: how do we expose per-user token buckets and global caps without adding infra? They asked about token refresh patterns for long-lived VS Code sessions.
- Security: SSO/SAML + audit logging + KMS for customer-managed keys for enterprise customers. Data residency question for EU customers — prefer dedicated region.
- Cost sensitivity: extension free tier for community, paid plans for enterprises; interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations to set batching/quantization for lower-cost per token on non-critical suggestions.
- POC success criteria: inline suggestion latency distribution (p50/p95), token cost per 1k suggestions, failure rate under 1% during simulated 500 dev concurrent session.
- Quote from eng: "If you give us a straightforward model pin API and predictable latency we can ship enterprise tier in H2".
- Action items: provide rate-limit integration doc, sample token management flows for VS Code background workers, draft SLA for dedicated pools, submit answers to security questionnaire (drive link).
- Stubs: Fireflies transcripts attached; will share internal design doc after security review.
